unit.why: A homiletic and ethical teaching against excessive wakefulness and asceticism. It cites the habits of the Seer of Lublin and the Besht's middle way. Its only anecdotal element is a one-line rebuke by the author's father to a man who deprived himself of sleep, which is a saying rather than a narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the sectioned discourse ('מענין שינה' heading at end of previous division). The next division starts a new section ('מענין של"ה') that contains a story.
